find: return { angle: held, nextHeld: held, nextHeldTicks: ticks - 1 };
replace: return { angle: solution, nextHeld: held, nextHeldTicks: ticks - 1 };
why: The hold IS issue #344's mechanism: while a span is live and the fresh solution has not drifted past AI_AIM_BREAK, the turret is sent to the angle the tank already committed to. Letting the fresh solution through restores exactly the per-tick re-solve the issue reports -- measured before the layer existed, the turret was perfectly still on only 42.53% of live ticks for teal and 72.93% for brown (arena1/pacifist, 60 seeds x 2 arenas x 2 player policies), micro-correcting on the rest at 60Hz.
killedBy: aim hold (issue #344) a held aim does NOT suppress the firing solution: hasSolution still reads the fresh solve
aim hold (issue #344) decideAi returns the HELD aim angle, not the fresh solution, while the span is live
holdAim keeps the held angle and counts down while the span is live and the fresh solution is close
holdAim measures the break across the shortest arc, so a hold survives the +/-pi seam
